scope: ChatGPT native-host discovery in WinMux macOS
root_cause: The desktop installer registers com.openai.codexextension for Chrome and Chromium; WinMux uses a separate user-data-dir and previously only fell back to these registrations for com.1password.1password.

permanent_fix.discovery: Read existing Chrome then Chromium registration only after normal user/system lookup misses; restrict fallback to the exact 1Password and ChatGPT host names.

validation.build_method: Isolated objects and test executable using the pinned Chromium toolchain and existing dependency objects.

limitations: Full desktop connection and side chat have not been verified.
WinMux is not listed as a supported browser in OpenAI documentation.
The permanent source fix requires a future browser build; the live profile is repaired via the registration symlink.
